about.title: Modern Web. Human Touch.
about.subtitle: I'm Jason Bini, a Junior Fullstack Web Developer based in Italy.
about.description: I build modern, high-performance web applications with a strong focus on user experience and brand identity. My stack is centered around React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS on the frontend, paired with backend tools that keep everything running smoothly under the hood. I got into web development because I was fascinated by the internet's power to tell stories, connect people and grow businesses. That fascination never left, it evolved into a professional skill set. Today I bring that same energy to every project I take on, treating each one as a unique problem to solve both creatively and technically. I'm constantly learning, constantly refining my craft and always looking for opportunities to build products that create a real impact for real people.
